title: Shared proof-state warm-up and gradual causal interchange at matched continuation budget

ownership.parent_result: AF-05 58-coordinate eligible causal comparisons absent; registered depth-stability advantage inconclusive

scientific_question: After establishing shared intermediate Horn proof-state competence, does gradually introducing causal code-interchange training improve unseen depth-4 and depth-5 counterfactual fidelity over the same number of extra status-only updates?

oracle.source: AF-05 fixed least-Horn-closure oracle and exact counterfactual donor roster, SHA-bound by corpus_manifest.json
oracle.visibility: Initial facts and public graph incidence only; inferred Q0/Q1 and final goal truth are absent from model input
oracle.intervention: After upstream TypedLoop recurrence patch one actual encoded subgoal-atom token, Q_selected for causal examples or Q_other for controls; decode and run downstream cell three times
oracle.target: Addressed examples use exact do(Q_selected := donorQ_selected) and recipient Q_other closure. Irrelevant examples use original recipient truth.
oracle.certificate: The AF-05 Lean 4.19.0 generated closed Boolean Horn certificates certify the oracle only; model output is independently scored.

data.reuse: All AF-05 canonical train/dev and four heldout families, identical hashes and donors
data.sampling: Each update samples 16 canonical depth2 and 16 canonical depth3 inputs independently from same fixed seed/width stream; one of two matched changed-Q donors selected deterministically; host copies are not duplicated as neural examples
data.strict_holdout_exclusion: Only train/dev can be accessed by trainer; all heldout is in separately invoked scorer after checkpoints saved

model.architecture: AF-05 exact original TypedLoop(16) with public 15 atoms/14 rule slots and typed attention; full 464 coordinate state
model.trainability: Native cell, encoders, heads, and typed codec updated throughout warm-up and continuation
model.source_pinning: Runtime reuses hash-pinned AF-02 cell and AF-05 implementation; AF-06 source hashes and weight exports pinned per run

training.warmup: Exactly 480 status-supervised updates with irrelevant-Q donor patch. Freeze common warmup checkpoint once; three continuation arms receive bitwise identical copies of all model tensors, including codec.
training.status: 160 additional status-supervised steps with irrelevant-Q control patch and original semantic targets
training.ramp: 160 additional steps, fraction of addressed patches per batch round(32*t/159) for t=0..159, using deterministic independent row permutation; remaining rows take irrelevant-Q patch with original truth
training.abrupt: 160 additional steps with all addressed-Q patches and independently computed counterfactual targets from first continuation update
training.per_update_loss: Clean goal CE +0.5 pre-Q CE +0.25 post-Q CE +0.10 probability commutation MSE +0.75 post-patch goal CE +0.30 post-patch Q CE. All arms use same terms and semantic labels appropriate to their patch type.
training.call_budget: Every update in all arms runs one full clean model, recipient/donor prefixes, and one patched suffix on the same true-length bucket, exact same number of TypedLoop cells; no unequal width or microbatch schedules
training.initialization: Seed and width fix fresh initialized model before warmup. Continuation samplers and donor choices match across all three arms. Runtime logs gradient norms, timing, addressed-patch counts, loss histories and source SHA.
training.checkpoint_policy: Final fixed step only, no dev-based early stop; dev consulted after each frozen phase for eligibility and never for optimizing model selection. Preserve all seeds, widths, failures and numerical records.
training.smoke: Engineering smoke runs may use shorter schedules but are retained with smoke=true and barred from registered aggregation

evaluation.eligibility: Shared warmup AND both status/ramp final models must each attain >=0.80 goal accuracy and >=0.80 joint-Q exact on train and dev, with each depth evaluated at its matched 4/6 loop count. Missing gates are inconclusive.
evaluation.primary_positive: For every eligible width2 seed, ramp minus status >=0.05 informative changed-goal patch accuracy in EACH heldout depth4/depth5 family, clean goal accuracy no more than 0.03 below status, untouched-Q correctness >=0.90, irrelevant-Q patch goal retention >=0.90, and no extra false-positive original goals.
evaluation.aggregation: Any eligible seed failing a required condition makes primary fail; pass requires all three eligible seeds passing, otherwise inconclusive.
evaluation.abrupt_comparison: Diagnostic registered ramp-minus-abrupt patch accuracy on each heldout; supports attributing gain to schedule but not part of primary causal-vs-status gate
evaluation.counterfactual_roster: Exactly two changed-Q donor pairs per input; retain raw clean and addressed/irrelevant/whole patch logits, actual patched code, original and oracle targets
evaluation.independent_replay: Recompute each original/patch label from deterministic source graph and donor tuple; recompute accuracy from raw logits and check saved per-token patch code and whole-donor direct logits after loading frozen checkpoint.
evaluation.scientific_scope: Synthetic Horn proof-state representation, not standalone neural Lean theorem proving or evidence of globally invertible recurrent dynamics
